evidence_boundary: This is a revision-6 build/tool recovery contract, not a device simulation result. It preserves and hash-binds the committed R05 19/29 build failure, including the successful R05 SuiteSparse and Trilinos installs and the missing-M4/Bison-data failure. R06 may reuse only the complete tree-hashed R05 SuiteSparse and Trilinos prefixes; it must not reuse the partial R05 Xyce build or any R05 output namespace. The registered GNU M4, GNU Bison and Flex sources are open-source build inputs, and the local AIM-Spice executable is excluded because auditable lawful license provenance is absent. A passing static contract establishes only that the recovery chain is frozen and reviewable. A later passing runner plus independent persisted-evidence check can establish only a reproducible pure-source serial Xyce binary, a scalar B-source tool self-test and parser-only frozen IGZO candidate syntax. These are not an IGZO equation, device curve, SPICE route comparison, physical parameter, experimental calibration or circuit result. M01 remains E0 until both formal open-source device-only routes and their independent persisted-evidence gate pass; C00, circuit, layout, PEX and HZO remain closed.
